blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is mapping the calamansi supply chain in Oriental Mindoro as part of efforts to develop a more organized, competitive and halal-ready industry in the province. DTI’s Supply Chain and Logistics Group, in partnership with the Philippine Association of Service Industries Inc. (PASIA), conducted a focus group discussion on the halal calamansi supply chain on Oct. 6 at the Provincial Agricultural Center in Victoria town. The activity brought together calamansi farmers, processors and retailers, as well as representatives from national and local government agencies and the academe. READ: Kanduli: The […]...
